_source: Blueprint L2 (finale frames) and L3 (truth ending, epilogue, summary). 'see', 'shows' and 'animation' are direction for the panel art, not on-screen text.

frames.see: Three witness panels and their resolved evidence cards.
frames.narration: I thought I was solving three separate stories.
frames.shows: Mira, Arun and Leela each hold one part of the same event.
frames.animation: Panels slide into one investigation board.

frames.narration: The clocks stopped. The night did not.
frames.shows: The fixed time is shown as a false anchor.

frames.see: Nia's clinic record beside the child from the memory echo.
frames.narration: I remembered a disappearance. I did not remember her name.
frames.shows: The child is Nia Vane, the person Elias was carrying.

frames.see: Master console and village network lit simultaneously.
frames.narration: Someone gave the lantern all of Veyra.
frames.shows: The activation record shows Elias opening every node.
frames.animation: Lines spread across the village map.

frames.see: Casebook threads converge on THE FIGURE.
frames.shows: Every decisive clue points to the same silhouette and tools.

frames.see: Anonymous case request beside old Elias handwriting.
frames.narration: I did not remember writing the case that brought me here.
frames.shows: The handwriting and paper match Elias's own archived notes.

frames.see: Close black silhouette holding the lantern staff.
frames.narration: I knew the shape because I had been carrying it for years.
frames.shows: The outline becomes the younger Elias.
frames.animation: Black mask dissolves from the edges inward.

frames.see: Young Elias activates the machine, then reaches for the self-purge control.
frames.narration: I caused the incident. Then I erased the person who caused it.
frames.shows: The original experiment, Nia, the village network and the self-memory purge are shown in one unedited record.

truthEnding.outcome: Elias remembers the entire Veyra incident and the player sees the canonical reconstructed truth.
truthEnding.narration: I came here looking for the person who erased the village. It was me.
truthEnding.finalState: The silhouette is gone; Elias is fully visible; Veyra remains quiet but no longer loops.

epilogue.outcome: The final page briefly shows the master log being archived under Elias's real name.
epilogue.narration: The truth was never missing. I was.
epilogue.panel: The village clock advances from 2:17 to 2:18.
epilogue.finalState: The casebook closes on a complete timeline with every required clue connected.

summary.title: Investigation complete.
summary.shows: The nine confirmed deductions, witness resolutions, optional evidence count, discovered locations, then Credits.
summary.replayHint: Some evidence was easier to miss.
